_comment: What a village and a city offer (asked by Adrien: a village is small, a city has everything). inn: the beds on offer (asked by Adrien: a choice when short of money): price in écus, heal = share of full life given back, food = belly filled up to (breakfast); names in i18n town.bed.<id>. sells: what the merchant has. buys: share of an item's price paid when the explorer sells it (food and what was gathered). forge: weapons sold by the smith. tavern: rumours heard there (ids, texts in i18n: rumor.<id>), one at a time, changing every half hour. dishes: what the tavern serves (food: how much it fills the belly, heal: life, price in écus; names in i18n: dish.<id>). flavour: how many lines of welcome there are for each (i18n town.flavour.<village|city>.<n>).
